A list of spells available to be prepared by the Paladin class.

Overview

Paladin spells are Prepared spells, so all Paladins have access to these spells (up to their Paladin level) and prepare a limited number of them at any one time.

Paladin spells will use the caster's Charisma modifier for Spell Save DC and Spell Attack rolls.
